Professional interpretation of the modeled findings

Relative priority

A-grade corridors are the highest-priority opportunities within this run—not globally and not by construction feasibility. B and C corridors may remain valuable where ownership, access, soils, overflow design or ecological context make them more practical.

Water-path relationship
